_comment: BusinessDecision with typed Remarks[] — each remark has a category via RemarkSource. Standard M27 field, used as structured annotations.

Remarks.Remark: Upgrade FMU framework to Level 3 (include structural uncertainty) before DG2 volumes.
Acquire additional core data in floodplain facies — current porosity model poorly constrained.
Reprocess 2019 4D seismic to confirm fault communication across NE boundary.
Porosity downgrade (0.18→0.14) adequately reflected in revised volumes. No further action needed.
WAG strategy from year 5 adds complexity. Recommend fallback to continuous water injection if WAG wells underperform.
Acquire CentralFlanks core data (minimum 3 wells) before DG3 to reduce remaining porosity uncertainty.
Confirm FPSO water injection capacity (35,000 bbl/d) with facilities team before FEED contract award.
Reservoir engineering lead recommends 2-segment phased approach (Alternative B) due to remaining porosity risk in peripheral segments. Overruled by project economics.
Include dynamic uncertainty (history match) in DG3 production forecast — current forecast is deterministic only.
Evaluate infill well potential in NorthHorst segment — upside not captured in base case.
Volumes updated 2026-02-12 (Activity: Drogon-DG2-VolumeUpdate). P50 STOIIP 312→287 MSm³.
Risk Drogon-FaultCompartment mitigated 2026-04-15 based on 4D seismic evidence. Severity High→Low.
